newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Gaming to issue debt -sources.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Gaming to issue debt -sources.

text.p: Alliance Gaming will issue $125 million in 10-year 144a senior subordinated notes through a Credit Suisse First Boston syndicate, market sources said.
The issue may be priced as early as next week, they said.

In conjunction with the issue, Alliance has previously set a tender offer for its $154 million in 12-7/8 percent senior secured notes due 2003. The offer's consent solicitation will expire on Thursday or Friday, said a source close to the deal.
Alliance Gaming did not immediately return phone calls.
Alliance, based in Las Vegas, Nevada, operates gambling devices and off-track betting parlors in Nevada and Louisiana.
